assets.prompt: Generate one elegant editorial concept photograph about multilingual website content planning. Exact landscape16:9 target1600x900. Three-quarter close-up camera angle, calm daylight on a dark oak table in a creative studio. Three upright thin booklets with simple paper tabs exactly labeled 'KO', 'EN', 'JA' in small clean black type, open white pages with only anonymous gray text-like horizontal strokes, one green highlighter, a large pale cream folded sheet with an abstract branching content map made of fine pencil lines and blank rectangles, a hand holding one page as if selecting what needs translation. Natural film photograph, rich forest-green fabric accent, muted butter-yellow bookmark, softly blurred background, tactile realistic paper and restrained art direction. The emphasis is prioritizing content in different languages, no laptop or browser screen, no glossy 3D icons. No identifiable people, no logos, no actual client data, no readable body text or statistics. Conceptual staged scene, not client evidence. All key subjects within safe margins. Only a single finished photographic image.

Create one clear flat editorial concept infographic showing multilingual page correspondence, exact landscape16:9 target1600x900. Refined geometric diagram on very pale lavender background with charcoal, forest green, lilac and butter-yellow accents. Two horizontal lanes: upper lane has three generously spaced rectangular page tiles, lower lane has three matching page tiles vertically aligned. Every tile has a dark simple header strip, one short rule and two tiny generic shapes; use only language labels 'KO' on upper tiles and 'EN' on lower tiles. Connect each vertically matching pair with TWO thin opposed arrows showing reciprocal language alternatives; green arrows with generous whitespace between lanes. Small circular language-selector icon to the left, a thin bracket for each lane, subtle editorial grid. Pages correspond one-to-one, no arrows from every page to a single home tile. A highly legible explanatory diagram with minimal hand-drawn ink texture, not 3D, not a screenshot, not photorealistic, no real websites, no claim of results. No Korean text, no URLs, no statistics, no flags, no logos, no fake dashboard. Only one final image.
